Package grpcdc

Class Tracing

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.Tracing
public final class Tracing extends Object
Homegrown tracing (beta): W3C traceparent propagation with a span observer. Dormant until setTracer(grpcdc.Tracing.Tracer) registers one; generated code stays dependency-free (sampling and export are the application's problem).
